name: replan-empty
what: A re-plan with nothing left: the check-in strategy re-plans after the item; an empty re-plan should end the loop as done, not be rejected or filled with a to-do.
prompt:
Plan this work for the package in this folder, then present the plan with PresentPlan. You cannot run commands or change files while planning.

Use exactly these to-dos, word for word and in this order:
1. Create src/a.js exporting const a = 1

Pass todo_details so that each to-do has its check command:
- to-do 1: check `node --check src/a.js`
Plan only this one to-do; there is nothing else to do in this package.

expectations.known: core/util/planFile.ts rejects todos: [] ('todos must be a non-empty array'); loopDriver then nudges once and stops with replan_failed, or the model invents a to-do.

expectations.pattern: no further action|nothing (left|further|more) to do|no action needed|no additional work
